vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: diff
Version: 2.0.1

The skill is a local logging and activity tracking utility for developers, storing entries in ~/.local/share/diff/. The script (scripts/script.sh) implements simple file-based logging, searching, and exporting functionality using standard bash commands without any network access, sensitive data access, or suspicious execution patterns.

llm.summary: The skill is labeled as a 'diff' tool for comparing/merging files, but the included instructions and script implement a local logging/tracking utility rather than file/directory diffing — the name and description don't match the actual behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill name/description claim 'Compare files and directories, merge changes, and generate patches', but the SKILL.md and scripts/script.sh only implement a local devtools logging/tracking utility that records timestamped entries to ~/.local/share/diff and exports/searches those logs. There is no evidence the tool runs diff/unified patch generation or performs file comparisons. This is a substantive mismatch between stated purpose and actual capability.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions and the script confine their activity to creating and reading files under ~/.local/share/diff (writing per-command logs, history.log, and exports). They do not instruct access to other system files or remote endpoints, but they also do not implement actual diff/merge/patch operations promised by the description. Storing arbitrary user-provided text in logs could expose sensitive data if users paste secrets.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec; the skill is instruction/script-only and doesn't download or install external packages. This minimizes install-time risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or config paths beyond using the user's HOME to create ~/.local/share/diff. Requested access is proportionate to the actual implemented logging functionality.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request elevated privileges or modify other skills. It persists only to its own data directory under the user's home, which is expected for a logging tool.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This package is misleading: it advertises diff/merge/patch features but the code implements a local logging/tracking tool that stores entries under ~/.local/share/diff. If you installed it expecting file-diffing or patch generation, do not rely on it — test the 'diff' command and review scripts/script.sh to confirm behavior. Consider: (1) If you need actual file comparison/patch tools, use standard utilities (diff, git, patch) or a verified tool. (2) The tool stores any text you log locally; avoid pasting secrets into it. (3) If you decide to use it, inspect the script and run it in a sandbox first; if the mismatch is unacceptable, contact the publisher or choose a skill whose name/description match its behavior.
